title: If he stays on here I am off.
html_source:
Stephen resents Haines, he’ll be leaving due to
Haines the Usurper by the end of the chapter.

anchor.text: If he stays on here I am off.
anchor.prefix: and growing fear. Out here in the dark with a man I don't know raving and moaning to himself about shooting a black panther. You saved men from drowning. I'm not a hero, however.
anchor.suffix:
Buck Mulligan frowned at the lather on his razorblade. He hopped down from his perch and began to search his trouser pockets hastily. 

1922#4

 — Scutter! he cried thickly.
anchor.canonical_text: If he stays on here I am off.
